why: The student wrote correct new code for an unseen problem: it starts a running minimum at data[0], updates it with Math.min in one pass, and prints the result, which is the transfer_to_a_new_program way at L4.

concepts.quote: double min = data[0]; for (double v : data) min = Math.min(min, v);
concepts.why: It starts from the first element, which no other value can wrongly beat, and keeps the smaller value in a single pass, so it correctly finds the minimum of a non-empty array.
It uses println correctly in new code to print the result on its own line.

concepts.quote: double min = data[0]; for (double v : data)
concepts.why: It uses double correctly for the minimum variable and the loop variable, matching the type of the double array.
